modulation.passive_factors_in_rates: Yes. Published dues already include the passive factors required by law: Detriments Malus +5% (materials that disrupt recycling), Not-on-MRL Malus (AML materials priced at least 20% above the average of similar Minimum Recyclables List materials; Not Collected materials at least 10% above similar AML), High Recycling Rate Bonus -5%. In 2026 the bonus showed on corrugated (base 0.083, bonus -0.003), glass, aluminum, steel and PET; no basket line carried a malus (per SPI).
modulation.active_bonuses: Statute (C.R.S. 25-17-709) requires CDPHE to publish an eco-modulation bonus schedule by 2026-01-01 to lower dues for producers meeting benchmarks. Statute (25-17-705) lists the behaviors to reward: less packaging, recyclability or commodity-value improvements, high postconsumer recycled content, reuse/refill design, high recycling and refill rates. CAA lists four active incentive forms (PCR Content, Reuse/Refill, Reduction, Enhancement; published April 2026). Benchmark values and bonus amounts were NOT confirmed.
state_targets: C.R.S. 25-17-705(4)(p): plan must set minimum collection, recycling and postconsumer-recycled-content targets for paper, glass, metal and plastic to strive to meet by 2030-01-01 and 2035-01-01 (statute has no percentages)
Approved CAA plan (2025-12-10), per secondary sources: recycling rate from about 25% (2022 baseline) to 41% in 2030 (Recycling Today); up to 60% of consumer packaging recycled by 2035 (Eco-Cycle)

notes: SECONDARY. The CAA 2026 Colorado Producer Dues Schedule (posted 2025-10-13) could not be opened (host blocked). Corrugated, film, PP film, laminates, glass, aluminum and steel come from SPI (2026-10-26) and agree with EcoEnclose (2026-10-14) where both print them. Kraft Paper, Paperboard and Other Paper Laminates come only from EcoEnclose. Rates are final dues (base plus maluses minus bonus), rounded to the cent. Left out: molded-pulp (no 2026 'Other Paper Packaging' rate found) and eps-foam (only the PS foamed CONTAINERS row, $1.72/lb, was found; the cushioning row was not).
